# FableCut

> A Premiere-style video editor that runs in the browser and keeps its entire
> timeline in one JSON file, so an AI agent can edit video through MCP or a
> REST API while a human watches the cut change. MIT licensed, zero npm
> dependencies, runs locally on your own machine.

FableCut is not a cloud service and has no black-box render API. The whole edit lives in `project.json`. An
agent rewrites that file the way it rewrites code; the open editor reloads in
about 150 ms. A human and an agent can work the same timeline at once.

## Facts

- License: MIT. Free for personal and commercial use. No account, no telemetry,
  no paid tier.
- Requirements: Node.js 18+ and a Chromium-based browser. ffmpeg on PATH is
  optional but recommended (fast export, upload remuxing, loudness
  normalization, auto-duck and noise reduction).
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/ronak-create/FableCut.git`, then
  `node server.js`, then open http://localhost:7777.
- The server binds 127.0.0.1 only. Media stays in a local folder; nothing is
  uploaded to a cloud service.
- Control surfaces: an MCP server (stdio, client-neutral), a REST API, and
  direct edits to `project.json` with live reload over server-sent events.
- Editing: multi-track video and audio (up to 16 per kind), per-clip volume,
  stereo pan, speed ramps, keyframes, transitions, titles with kinetic text
  animation, SVG library, chroma key, AI background removal.
- Audio: a mixer with track faders, pan, mute / solo and meters; submix buses;
  clip gain; effect chains (EQ, filters, compressor, limiter, gate, delay,
  reverb, distortion, stereo width, pitch shift) with presets and keyframed
  parameters; loudness normalization (LUFS); auto-duck; crossfades; noise
  reduction.
- Color: a Color workspace with GPU grading per clip or adjustment layer
  (lift / gamma / gain / offset wheels, exposure, white balance with a picker,
  blacks / shadows / midtones / highlights / whites, log-style contrast and
  pivot, soft rolloff, saturation, luma / RGB curves and hue vs hue / sat /
  luma and sat vs luma curves) and live scopes (waveform, RGB parade,
  vectorscope, histogram). Agents grade with the `setGrade` patch op and read
  the result as numbers with `fablecut_scopes`.
- Export: fast ffmpeg export via encoding profiles, WebCodecs hardware export
  (browser encodes H.264, server muxes), and a realtime MediaRecorder fallback.
  Agents can start an export themselves (`fablecut_export`), in the open editor
  or a headless browser.
- Also installable as a Claude Code plugin, which registers the MCP server and
  adds `edit-video` and `remake-reel` skills.
